title: Self-hosted file transfer with jalco-drop
description: Share files, folders, pastes and screen recordings as links that render their content by type, stored in Neon Object Storage. Agents can upload and read them too.

environment.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
environment.description: A long random string, for example from openssl rand -base64 32, that signs in to /admin and the upload API. Keep it in a password manager.

environment.name: OWNER_NAME
environment.description: The name that shared links show as "<name> sent you". It defaults to Someone, and you can change it later under Settings in /admin.

environment.name: SITE_NAME
environment.description: The site name that the interface shows. It defaults to jalco-drop.

environment.name: ACCENT_COLOR
environment.description: The accent colour that the site uses, as a hex value such as #ff4f00.

environment.name: CODE_THEME
environment.description: The theme that the site uses to highlight code, such as pierre-dark, vesper or github-dark.

environment.name: HOME_URL
environment.description: The URL that jalco-drop sends visitors to when they open the bare URL. It defaults to https://www.google.com/.

environment.name: DROPS_BUCKET
environment.description: The Object Storage bucket that stores drops. It defaults to drops.

environment.name: RATE_LIMIT
environment.description: Set it to off to disable the per-IP limit of 60 requests a minute, for example in tests.
